# Third-party browser assets

These files are served locally so the dashboard does not depend on a CDN at runtime.

- Web Awesome 3.9.0 (`static/vendor/webawesome/`), Copyright Fonticons, Inc., MIT license.
- Font Awesome Free 7.2.0 (`static/vendor/fontawesome/`), Copyright Fonticons, Inc., Font Awesome Free License (icons: CC BY 4.0; code: MIT).
- Chart.js 4.5.1 (`static/vendor/chart.umd.min.js`), Copyright Chart.js contributors, MIT license.
- hls.js 1.6.16 (`static/vendor/hls.min.js`), Copyright hls.js contributors, Apache License 2.0.

The upstream packages include their full license text and metadata where distributed. Their source
repositories are https://github.com/shoelace-style/webawesome,
https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js, and https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js.
